messages:
jun: FYI — Helios-v1 int6 shadow run on en-zh translation shows weird span boundary shifts in CJK samples. BLEU ~ -0.9 on a small testset, but more concerning: token-level inserts (ASCII space) appearing in outputs. Repro steps & sample below.

anya: can you paste a failing sample? quick check: tokenizer/version? :thinking:

jun: Tokenizer is unchanged (tokenizer v2.3). Repro command:
```
./rhd-eval --model helios-v1 --quant int6 --dataset zh_test --seed 42 --batch 8
```
Output diffs (gold / float32 / int6):
```
gold: 今天下午我们去图书馆看书。
float32: 今天下午我们去图书馆看书。
int6: 今 天下午我们去图书馆看书。
```
Note the space after the first character in int6.

mike: that's... odd. Are these coming from tokenizer detokenize or model sampling? try dumping tokens.

jun: tokens (unicode codepoints shown):
```
float32 tokens: [U+4ECA, U+5929, U+4E0B, U+534A, ...]  // expected sequence
int6 tokens:   [U+4ECA, U+0020, U+5929, U+4E0B, U+534A, ...]  // 0x20 inserted
```
We see a U+0020 (space) interleaved between han ideographs in the int6 run.

olga: does this only happen on the int6 kernel? any difference when using alternative kernel (legacy-gemm)?

jun: quick smoke with legacy-gemm: int6 on legacy-gemm produced correct detok (no space). So likely a post-quant inference kernel edge-case.

anya: could be KV-cache alignment or continuous-batching padding trim. Was this in streaming? any prefix cache used?

jun: it's offline eval (no streaming) but we warm prefix cache for repeated context. Disabling prefix cache removed the space in the sample — suspicious.

mike: PR 6423 updated the quant reorder/pack optimization in kernels last week. rolling that back for canary might help. I'll spin a canary without that change.

ciara-bot: triage created: #TI-9845 — assign eng-runtime + eng-ml. Link: https://redwood/triage/TI-9845

olga: good. Jun: please re-run with RUNTIME_DEBUG=1 and attach the pre-detok token stream. Also include model weights checksum so infra can reproduce.

jun: attaching minimal dump excerpt below (sanitized):
```
MODEL: helios-v1-int6-q5
WEIGHT-SHA: abcdef1234567890
TOKEN-STREAM-RAW:
[U+4ECA][U+0020][U+5929][U+4E0B]...  // shows U+0020 injected between U+4ECA and U+5929
```

anya: thanks. next steps: mike to test kernel revert on canary; jun to re-run with full debug dump; olga to audit prefix-cache offset changes from last runtime patch.

mike: canary deployed (revert quant-reorder). brief smoke: int6 outputs now match float32 for the sample — looks like that change introduced an off-by-one when packing tokens into batched tensors. will run the full eval sweep.

jun: rerun (full 12k sample sweep) finished. BLEU delta back to -0.05 (within noise). No more space insertions on verified samples. Debug dump uploaded to the triage ticket.

anya: great. let's add a regression unit test that covers adjacent CJK packing boundary with prefix-cache enabled. test target: eng-runtime/tests/test_quant_pack_cjk.py.

olga: note for release notes: regression caused by kernel reorder optimization (PR 6423) — reverted on canary; plan: reintroduce perf-safe packing that preserves token alignment.

mike: :thumbsup: I'll follow up with perf delta after we implement a fix that keeps packing correctness.

jun: closing the triage for now; will reopen if any new failures surface. thanks all :heart:
